therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: pulmonary vasodilation / reduction of pulmonary vascular resistance
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with pulmonary hypertension undergoing hypoxia and normoxia challenge
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Pulmonary Vascular Resistance (PVR) at baseline and four subsequent time points

results.effect_size: PVR reduced from 67 dyn*sec/cm^5 (normoxia) to 46 dyn*sec/cm^5 (normoxia + BQ-123); hypoxia-induced PVR rise attenuated from 119 to 85 dyn*sec/cm^5 with BQ-123
results.target_engagement_evidence: BQ-123 reduced PVR under normoxia and attenuated hypoxia-induced PVR elevation, consistent with ETA receptor blockade
biomarker_changes: Mean PAP at baseline: 10 mmHg; hypoxia: 15 mmHg; normoxia: 10 mmHg; normoxia + BQ-123: 9 mmHg; hypoxia + BQ-123: 14 mmHg
Cardiac output at baseline: 5.3 L/min; hypoxia: 6.7 L/min; normoxia: 5.2 L/min; normoxia + BQ-123: 6.4 L/min; hypoxia + BQ-123: 8.3 L/min
subgroup_findings: BQ-123 reduced PVR from 67 to 46 dyn*sec/cm^5 under normoxia conditions
BQ-123 attenuated hypoxia-induced PVR rise (119 vs 85 dyn*sec/cm^5)
BQ-123 reduced SVR under normoxia (1351 to 1069 dyn*sec/cm^5) and hypoxia (1050 to 828 dyn*sec/cm^5)
BQ-123 increased cardiac output under normoxia (5.2 to 6.4 L/min) and hypoxia (6.7 to 8.3 L/min)

context.duration: single session with sequential hypoxia/normoxia/BQ-123 challenge periods
